t: You're looking at the Church of the Immaculate Conception, better known as Farm Street Church. It's a Catholic parish church in Mayfair, run by the Society of Jesus, the Jesuits. The architect was Joseph John Scoles, who lived from 1798 to 1863. He was an English Gothic Revival architect, and he designed many Roman Catholic churches, so this building belongs to a larger body of his work. Notice the Gothic character of the design, which is exactly the style he worked in.
